subject: social_studies
concept: Comparing a tradition or celebration from the student's own background to a similar one from a different culture
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches two celebrations from different cultures that share a similar underlying purpose
exercise.abstract: Student compares a tradition from their own background to one from a different culture, identifying a genuine similarity and difference

assessment.success_marker: student engages respectfully and specifically with both the similarity and the difference between the two traditions
